description: Bind Employee ID, Manager ID and Name. That is the whole setup. SmartVisuals Org Chart derives the reporting tree from the ids in the table your HR system already exports. No PATH and PATHITEM measures, no parent-child hierarchy, no calculated column per level, no static root row invented to keep a visual happy. IT DOES NOT BREAK The org chart shelf is full of error screens: two or more root nodes, the top person must have ID 1, a blank visual the moment a slicer removes the CEO. This one renders anyway and explains what it did, in a strip under the chart. All of this is free, in every tier: Several people at the top stand side by side. There is no single-root rule. A manager id that is not in the table is not an error: those people are grouped under Unassigned and counted, or promoted to their own tree if you prefer. A reporting loop is cut at one link, everybody stays visible, and the cut is named. Duplicate ids, blank ids, self-managed rows and dotted lines pointing at someone who left are each handled and counted. A slicer that filters away the top of the organisation gives you a filtered view, not an error. THE WHOLE CHART IS FREE Any id type, any size of organisation, no node cap. Expand and collapse that survives a refresh, a bookmark and a reopen, because the state lives in the report, not in browser storage. Branch view: any person becomes the root, the path back to…
